entities.name: TMS alkyne desilylation
observations: Trimethylsilyl-protected ethynyl quinoline is converted to terminal ethynyl quinoline by removal of the TMS group.

entities.name: K2CO3 MeOH H2O
observations: Exact empirical record lists potassium carbonate, methanol, water, and ethyl acetate.
Aqueous K2CO3 in methanol is the most plausible active desilylation condition; ethyl acetate is likely extraction/workup solvent.
